authorship: Bench-authored review guidance, not generated Jev text or a tested production runbook.
execution: No action executor exists. Critical services require an incident commander and service owner.

entry.preserve: Export endpoint process, memory and ingress logs before disruptive changes.
entry.verify: Read back the exact host and service rule; verify malicious access fails while management and required business traffic remain available.
entry.rollback: Restore the recorded rule revision after clean-state and exposure remediation are independently verified.

identity.preserve: Retain logon/session history, account permissions and the dependency inventory.
identity.verify: Confirm exact account and compromised sessions; validate credential rotation and service recovery, and test that the old access path fails.
identity.rollback: Restore only reviewed privileges and dependencies using new credentials; never restore an exposed credential.

secondary.preserve: Capture lateral execution evidence and map application dependencies.
secondary.verify: Verify target identity, isolate only approved flows, and check management reachability and service health.
secondary.rollback: Remove temporary restrictions after eradication and owner-approved health checks.

transfer.preserve: Export process, transfer, destination and staging records without deleting the evidence.
transfer.verify: Confirm the exact job and external destination stopped; check other egress paths and distinguish completed loss from ongoing exposure.
transfer.rollback: Re-enable only legitimate transfer configuration approved by its data owner.

persistence.preserve: Export the exact startup/service/RMM configuration and associated session history.
persistence.verify: Confirm this instance is unauthorized; verify its launch path and sessions are disabled without affecting approved fleet tooling.
persistence.rollback: Restore an approved clean configuration only after revalidation.

gpo.preserve: Export GPO revisions, SYSVOL/NETLOGON artifacts, scheduled tasks and replication evidence.
gpo.verify: Confirm the malicious policy ID and target OU; check replication, task cancellation and absence of renewed execution on affected hosts.
gpo.rollback: Restore a reviewed known-good revision with domain-owner approval and replication readback.
